name: Admin Tailor – Professional Brand Customizer
author: Jahidur Nadim

sections.description:
Turn WordPress into YOUR Brand’s Platform

Admin Tailor is the ultimate white-label WordPress solution that transforms generic WordPress admin and login areas into professionally branded experiences. Perfect for agencies, freelancers, consultants, and businesses who want to present a cohesive brand identity to clients and users.

Why Professional Branding Matters:
✓ Build trust and credibility with clients
✓ Reinforce your professional image
✓ Create seamless brand experiences
✓ Stand out from generic WordPress sites
✓ Increase client retention and referrals

🎨 LOGIN PAGE BRANDING

Transform the WordPress login experience into your brand’s gateway:

  • Custom Brand Logo – Replace WordPress logo with your brand
  • Brand Color Schemes – Match your corporate colors perfectly
  • Custom Background Images – Use your own branded backgrounds
  • Professional Patterns – 15+ built-in professional patterns
  • Form Styling – Modern rounded corners, shadows, transparency
  • Custom Error Messages – Branded user communications
  • Logo Border Radius – Perfect logo presentation

🚀 DASHBOARD TRANSFORMATION

Complete WordPress admin area branding:

  • Custom Admin Bar Colors – Match your brand palette
  • Menu Highlight Colors – Consistent color schemes
  • Custom Footer Text – Remove WordPress branding
  • Hide WordPress Logo – Clean, professional interface
  • Welcome Panel Control – Streamlined dashboard

💼 BUSINESS FEATURES

Professional tools for agencies and businesses:

  • Export/Import Settings – Quick client site setup
  • Custom CSS Support – Advanced customization
  • One-Click Reset – Easy configuration management
  • Client-Ready Interface – Professional presentation
  • Performance Optimized – Fast, lightweight code

👥 PERFECT FOR:

  • Agencies – Brand client sites professionally
  • Freelancers – Showcase your expertise
  • Consultants – Build trust with branded experiences
  • Businesses – Maintain brand consistency
  • Developers – Quick white-label deployment

🔧 EASY SETUP

No coding required! Simple point-and-click interface gets you branded in minutes. Upload your logo, set your colors, and instantly transform WordPress into your professional platform.

⚡ PERFORMANCE FIRST

Built with WordPress standards and optimized for speed. Only loads resources when needed, ensuring your site remains fast while looking professional.

Support

Professional Support:
For technical support, customization requests, or business inquiries:
📧 Email: jahidurnadim@gmail.com
🐛 Issues: Report bugs and request features
💼 Custom Development: Not available for hire, only available for consultancy.

Quick Help:
* Check the FAQ section for common questions
* Use the built-in help text in settings
* Export your settings before making major changes

Privacy Policy

Admin Tailor does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All customizations are stored locally in your WordPress database. The plugin respects user privacy and follows WordPress privacy guidelines.

Credits

  • Icons: Flaticon (https://www.flaticon.com/free-icons/customize)
  • Patterns: Subtle Patterns (https://www.toptal.com/designers/subtlepatterns)
  • Graphics: Unsplash (https://unsplash.com)
  • SVG Elements: Flevix (https://flevix.com)

Built with ❤️ for the WordPress community.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:
1. Go to your WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
2. Search for “Admin Tailor”
3. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
4. Navigate to Settings → Admin Tailor
5. Upload your logo, set colors, and brand your site!

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file
2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
3. Activate through the Plugins menu
4. Configure in Settings → Admin Tailor

Quick Start:
Visit Settings → Admin Tailor and start customizing! Your changes appear instantly.
sections.faq:
Is this suitable for client sites?

Absolutely! Admin Tailor is specifically designed for agencies and freelancers who build sites for clients. The white-label features help you maintain professional branding throughout the client experience.

Will this slow down my website?

No! Admin Tailor is performance-optimized and only loads resources when needed. The plugin follows WordPress best practices and won’t impact your site speed.

Can I use my own background images?

Yes! Upload any custom background image for the login page. The plugin automatically optimizes display for perfect presentation.

Does this work with multisite?

The plugin works on individual sites. For multisite networks, install on each site where you want branding applied.

Can I export settings to other sites?

Yes! The export/import feature lets you quickly apply the same branding across multiple client sites.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes! Admin Tailor includes full translation support for international use.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

WordPress returns to default appearance immediately. All your settings are safely stored and will reappear if you reactivate.
